options: When it spends more time servicing page faults than executing processes
When it spends more time executing than paging

questions.statement: Why can a process repeatedly page fault during thrashing?
options: It replaces a page that it needs again immediately

questions.statement: What model is the working set model based on?
What happens if enough frames are allocated for the current locality?
options: The process only faults when it moves to a new locality

questions.statement: What happens if allocated frames are fewer than the current locality size?
options: The process is bound to thrash

questions.statement: What does the page-fault-frequency technique attempt to control?
What should be done when the page-fault rate is too high?
What may be true when the page-fault rate is too low?
options: The process may have too many frames

questions.statement: What bounds are established in page-fault frequency control?
options: Upper and lower bounds for the desired page-fault rate

questions.statement: What happens if the page-fault rate exceeds the upper limit?
What happens if the page-fault rate falls below the lower limit?
options: Remove a frame from the process

questions.statement: What is the purpose of controlling page-fault rate?
Which concept explains why enough frames can reduce thrashing for a locality?
What is the direct relationship between insufficient frames and page faults described in the notes?
options: Insufficient frames for active pages cause frequent page faults
More frames always cause more faults
Frames have no relationship to faults

questions.statement: What does the OS repeatedly do during thrashing?
options: Replace pages and service page faults

questions.statement: Why is replacing an active page problematic?
options: It cannot be stored on disk
The page will be needed again immediately

questions.statement: What does the working set represent conceptually in the notes?
options: The current locality of a process

questions.statement: Which two techniques are explicitly listed for handling thrashing?
options: Working Set Model and Page Fault Frequency
